title.zh: Thailand finalizes rules paving way for Bitcoin, Ether ETFs
title.en: Thailand finalizes rules paving way for Bitcoin, Ether ETFs

current_state.zh: Thailand's SEC finalized rules allowing Bitcoin and Ether ETFs to list exclusively on the Stock Exchange of Thailand starting October 16, 2026, while barring retail access to overseas crypto ETF products.
current_state.en: Thailand's SEC finalized rules allowing Bitcoin and Ether ETFs to list exclusively on the Stock Exchange of Thailand starting October 16, 2026, while barring retail access to overseas crypto ETF products.
